name: GSK3B interacting protein
pathways: negative regulation of protein kinase activity

function.text: GSKIP encodes GSK3B-interacting protein. Annotated molecular activities include kinase regulator activity and protein kinase inhibitor activity. It participates in negative regulation of protein kinase activity and regulation of Wnt signaling pathway.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
